_: Machine-readable wire schema for the probe measurement gate. PROBE_SCHEMA_2.md is the prose; THIS is the contract a producer targets and the one tests validate against, so the two cannot drift. NO PRODUCER EXISTS YET: the active AutomationEngine.cpp still matches the staged observer transaction's `before` hash.

conventions.integers: Every *_us, *_ns, *_hz, *_seq, *_id, *_revision and *_epoch field is an exact integer. It may be carried as a JSON number or as a decimal STRING (the native container writes 64-bit values as strings); a consumer must accept both and must reject a float with a fractional part, a bool, or a non-numeric string.
conventions.units: _us = microseconds, _ns = nanoseconds, _hz = ticks per second. A bare _ms field is NOT part of this schema; milliseconds were the source of a unit defect and are not carried.
conventions.clocks: Every timestamp names its domain by field suffix: _engine_us = engine monotonic microseconds; _ns = Python perf_counter_ns; _epoch_us = Unix epoch microseconds; qpc/_qpc = journal QPC ticks. Microseconds are NEVER added to ticks: conversion scales by the owning journal's qpc_hz.
conventions.sign: assigned_delta_us POSITIVE means a LATER command. banner_trim_us POSITIVE means an EARLIER command. They have OPPOSITE signs and must never be added.
conventions.probability: assignment_probability is an exact rational written "n/d" (e.g. "1/3"). A bare integer has no defined scale and is rejected.
conventions.absent: A field that is absent is UNKNOWN. It is never zero, never the previous value, and never inferred from a neighbouring record.
conventions.cardinality: `one` = exactly one per physical shot. `one_per_attempt` = at most one per (shot, attempt). `many` = zero or more. Cardinality violations are AMBIGUOUS, never resolved by last-wins.

identity._note: worker_execution is the FULL scope. A target_revision on its own is not an identity; revision 4 under another token is a different execution.

name_collisions.physical_epoch: the physical SHOT identity. Formerly emitted as `BANNER TRIM release_seq`.
name_collisions.native_release_seq: a release counter. Formerly emitted as native `Release delivery identity release_seq`.
name_collisions._rule: A field literally named `release_seq` is REFUSED. The two counters above have historically shared that name and their values coincide.

enums._accepted: A revision is ACCEPTED only on result 0 of arm_result or retarget_result. Every other value is a refusal and leaves the previously accepted revision authoritative.
enums._coverage_note: `absent` (the panel has no coverage cell) and `unreadable` (it has one and the reader failed) are DIFFERENT and must not be merged.

required.learning_freeze_mask: token list (string of comma-separated tokens, or array)

constraints: max_abs_offset_us must be a positive int and MUST NOT exceed 25000 (the devFireOffsetForShotMs hard bound).
learning_freeze_mask is matched by TOKEN, never substring: `not_banner_trim` contains `banner_trim` and must NOT count as frozen.
the mask MUST contain `banner_trim` and `oracle`; freezing only the paths the dev hook already fences is not freezing the loop under test.
repeated manifests must be byte-identical; differing ones are CONTRADICTORY.

clock_bridge.scope: engine context (NOT a shot; carries no physical_epoch)
constraints: Scoped to (process identity, context). A second process choosing the same context number MUST NOT borrow this segment.
Conversion requires an APPLICABLE segment whose bracket CONTAINS the timestamp. A nearest segment is not applicable.
A timestamp between two segments is a CLOCK DISCONTINUITY, a distinct defect from being outside all of them.
uncertainty_us must be present, non-negative, and <= the manifest's clock_tolerance_us.

shot_press.emit: when the native physical edge is committed
constraints: A Python message-receipt timestamp MUST NOT substitute for the physical edge.

native_onset.emit: when native ownership/onset is actually latched
constraints: Instrument BOTH ordinary fresh acceptance and the promoted ownership-seed path.
Record the ORIGINAL seed provenance, not the latest frame at promotion time.
latched_engine_us is when the onset became KNOWN. first_meter_seen_engine_us may be BACKDATED for a promoted seed, so only latched_engine_us may be compared for ordering.
native_onset_us must be >= 0 and valid must be 1 for the onset to be usable.

resolved_trim_key is the key that ACTUALLY supplied the trim. BannerLeadTrim::trimMsForType uses resolvedKey(...), which may fall back to a different key than the requested tempo. `unknown` is refused; a fallback resolution is normal and accepted.

The native-owner reference is REQUIRED. A Python record describes a NATIVE-owned shot; using the emitting journal's identity files it as a separate Python-owned shot and the cross-process join fails silently.
Emit only when note_onset accepts the FIRST observation. Never reconstruct from a later native_frame row and never substitute onset_engine_estimate_ms.
Reader acceptance and native ownership acceptance are DIFFERENT events. Their frames may legitimately differ and neither may be derived from the other.

probe_assignment.emit: after eligibility is fixed, before any displaced arm
constraints: ONE assignment_id per physical shot. It MUST survive attempt and token changes; the existing hook caches by shot_.armToken, which is not this contract.
Emit ZERO-offset assignments too, and emit eligibility/accounting records for EXCLUDED shots.
|assigned_delta_us| must not exceed the manifest's max_abs_offset_us.
experiment_id must match the manifest.
Ordering: eligibility_fixed_engine_us >= latched_engine_us, and assigned_engine_us >= eligibility_fixed_engine_us.

schedule_plan.emit: inside AutomationEngine::scheduleFire, for EVERY arm / re-arm / retarget
constraints: Capture-phase locking happens AFTER the offset hook and can CLIP an offset targeting the past, so `DEV FIRE OFFSET APPLIED` alone is not sufficient evidence.

handoff_deadline_us is the value ACTUALLY PASSED TO THE WORKER, after every downstream transformation including tickAlignedFireDeadlineMs, which runs AFTER scheduleFire. The worker's accepted deadline must equal it; a difference with no accounted transformation means the plan does not explain the target that executed.

scheduleFire is NOT every deadline transition: in-place refinement commits elsewhere and the controller can nudge the deadline again before arming. Every transition must be recorded, not only the ones inside scheduleFire.
zero_offset_shadow_deadline_us must be computed from the SAME immutable inputs through a PURE transformation. It must NEVER be obtained by re-running mutating controller logic.
The shadow is a counterfactual for THIS scheduling transformation only. It is not the trajectory the shot would have followed untreated.
config_revision must match the manifest, or an accounted transition must exist.

worker.emit: at mailbox operations, claim and dispatch
constraints: operation_id is returned on REFUSALS too. A refused retarget leaves the previously accepted revision authoritative.
Copy identifiers from the immutable operation / claimed target, NEVER from mutable current shot state.
accepted_deadline_us is emitted only on acceptance. A refusal's deadline is the REQUESTED value.
An accepting record must not appear after the dispatch it would authorise.
Emit explicit cancellation / abandonment terminal records so a claim without a dispatch stays explainable.
A field named `release_seq` is REFUSED; see name_collisions.
The scope (token, route_generation, operation_id, target_revision) must equal the dispatched scope.
No record here implies console or game receipt.

shot_verdict.emit: when the reader accepts and attributes the banner
constraints: The native-owner reference is REQUIRED, for the same reason as reader_onset.
A MISSING grade is not EXCELLENT. Absence is reported as absence.
A cancellation BEFORE arming owes no dispatch. A shot reported `released` owes press, onset, plan, an accepted-revision worker chain, a release link and a verdict.
An already-issued command is NOT erased by a later cancellation label, so `killed` still owes its execution evidence.
Cancelled and clipped assignments remain in the experimental accounting.

derived_measurements.scheduling_tardiness: command_us - the accepted deadline of the DISPATCHED revision
_notes: All five are ENGINE-CLOCK ONLY and require no conversion. A missing clock_bridge does not block them.
scheduling_displacement is a SCHEDULING quantity. It is NOT delivered-command displacement, and neither it nor tardiness supplies a counterfactual command time for an untreated shot.
Every derived value is WITHHELD when the lineage it rests on is contradictory.
None implies console or game receipt.

displacement_fidelity_us._note: This is a TREATMENT FIDELITY threshold. It is NOT a clock tolerance and NOT a requirement that scheduling_tardiness stay under 2 ms. A large, accurately measured tardiness is a FINDING, not a measurement failure.

_rules: The four shot verdicts are reported SEPARATELY and never collapsed into one `valid shot` filter. Collapsing them is how a non-adherent assignment quietly leaves the primary randomised comparison.
MISSING evidence is UNVERIFIABLE. Only an OBSERVED contradiction is NONADHERENT.
Non-adherent assignments are reported WITH their arm, dose, block and stratum, never dropped. Intention-to-treat needs the label.
The gate is CAPTURE-level and separate from every shot verdict. Rows are always preserved; readiness is what gets withheld.
Exit status 0 means GATE PASSED, not `the report rendered`.
